impact:
WHERE THE DEFECT IS
apps/web/src/screens/start/FuelPanel.tsx:42-52 — `add` and `remove` invalidate only ["fuel","today"]. The update mutation (T-046) and the target save also invalidate ["fuel","history"], which TrendsScreen's adherence chart reads.

WHERE IT IS TRIGGERED FROM
Logging or removing food on the Start screen, then opening Trends while a cached history query is still fresh (staleTime 10s, apps/web/src/lib/query/query-client.ts).

VERIFIED vs SUSPECTED
Verified by reading the invalidation calls at HEAD (5abaf65); line numbers re-checked after filing. The visible staleness is suspected, not reproduced: navigating to Trends refetches once staleTime has passed, so the window is short.

FIX
Invalidate ["fuel","history"] in both onSuccess handlers, as update and saveTarget already do.
resolution: Resolved by T-047. Every fuel mutation (log, edit, remove, target) now invalidates the whole ["fuel"] prefix (FUEL_KEY in apps/web/src/screens/fuel/fuel-day.ts), which includes ["fuel","history"]. Back-dating made a per-day invalidation wrong anyway: moving an entry changes the day it left and the day it landed on.
title: Adding or removing a fuel entry does not invalidate fuel history
